narration: Leadership memo. Use A I more.

big: AI writes the PR in minutes.
narration: So we did. A I writes the pull request in minutes. Great. Now what?

caption: Review is the bottleneck.
narration: Day one: waiting for review. Day two: still waiting. Day three: looks good, please rebase. Review is the bottleneck.

caption: It keeps going down.
narration: Meanwhile, GitHub keeps falling over. August sixth: Actions down for about ten hours. August seventeenth: twenty percent errors on the web and A P I. October seventh: pull requests and Actions, degraded again.

caption: That's the scoreboard.
narration: One tracker counted two hundred fifty seven incidents in a year. Forty eight of them major.
So I built snapgit. Review, with a timer.

code:
$ snapgit snap wip/login
📸 wip/login will disappear in 1d (2026-10-11 18:36Z). Commit fast.
caption: Timer on. Can't extend it.
narration: Every branch gets a self destruct timer. On by default. And nobody can extend it.

code:
$ snapgit pr send -r origin
📨 sent "Fix login" (wip/login -> main), 1 CI check passed

$ snapgit pr open d37dd68f
⏳ the fuse is lit: wip/login merges into main in 1m unless you run: snapgit pr reject d37dd68f
caption: CI runs. 60s fuse. One button.
narration: Send a pull request, and C I runs first. Then someone opens it, and a sixty second fuse is lit. They can read every changed line. They get one button: reject.

caption: Open. Read. Race the clock.
narration: Prefer a browser? Same thing, on the web. Open it, read the diff, and watch the clock.

code:
(61 seconds later)
$ snapgit sweep -r origin
🔀 PR d37dd68f: nobody rejected it, so wip/login merged into main (1 CI check passed) and was pushed
👻 ghosted wip/login (was 30e2104). Undo: git branch wip/login 30e2104
caption: It merges. No queue.
narration: Nobody rejects it? It merges. No queue. No waiting.

code:
$ snapgit pr send wip/ai-login
😬 not sent: wip/ai-login failed CI before anyone had to look at it ("tests" exited 1)
   CI said no. The branch has left the building. PR 67aab67a "AI login rewrite" failed the "tests" check (exit 1). Shame on: Claudio, Claude Sonnet (agent). wip/ai-login is self-destructing. Fix it and send it again.
   | FAIL login.test.js: login() returned undefined
👻 ghosted wip/ai-login (was 09313a6). Undo: git branch wip/ai-login 09313a6
caption: Shame. Branch gone.
narration: And when the A I's code fails C I? The authors get shamed. Human or agent. Then the branch self destructs.

code:
$ snapgit streak
🔥 1 day streak. Longest: 1.

$ snapgit story
📖 your story, last 1d
   10b4462  Merge wip/login into main  (origin/main)
   4a649a8  init  (no branch tip)
   30e2104  fix login  (no branch tip)
   🔥 1 day streak
   (this story will not be saved)
caption: Streaks. Stories.
narration: Yes, there are commit streaks. And stories that disappear. Because why not.
No servers. Nothing to take down. snapgit. Link in bio. [pause 0.5] Hosted on GitHub. [pause 1.4] We know.
